senses.gloss:
ओघः [उच्-घञ् पृषो˚ घ]
1 A flood,
stream, current; पुनरोधेन हि युज्यते
नदी Ku. 4. 44; so रुधिर˚, बाष्प˚ &c.
--2 An inundation.
--3 A heap,
quantity, mass, multitude; बाण˚, अघ˚,
जन˚ &c.
--4 The whole.
--5
Continuity.
--6 Quick time in music.
--7
Tradition, traditional instruction.
--8
A kind of dance.
